package.description: Governed, sovereign AI workstation — local-first, cites its sources, abstains instead of guessing.

en-US.description: Governed, sovereign AI workstation — local-first, cites its sources, abstains instead of guessing.
en-US.longDescription:
Noetica is a local-first desktop workstation for governed AI. It runs models on
your own machine, grounds answers in your own knowledge graph, cites its sources,
and returns "insufficient evidence" instead of guessing — so an answer can be
defended, not just produced. On-device inference, verified compute, and a sealed
provenance receipt on every answer.
en-US.name: Noetica
